t: Section 13442(b) of the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act  of 1993 (Public Law 103–66) is amended by striking “May 12, 1995” and inserting “December 31, 1995”.

fable.w: This section only amends a date in Section 13442(b) of the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1993, replacing "May 12, 1995" with "December 31, 1995". There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment that changes a specific date in a previous statute. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory committees, or coordination with outside parties. It is purely an internal legislative correction.
qwen_block.s: Section 13442(b) of the Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1993 (Public Law 103–66) is amended by striking “May 12, 1995” and inserting “December 31, 1995”.

opus.w: This section only amends another law by replacing one date with a later one ("May 12, 1995" becomes "December 31, 1995"). Its text sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. The tempting reading is that the amended provision might itself involve outside parties, but that provision isn't quoted here, and a date change alone brings no one from outside the federal government into a federal decision.

However, the text itself contains no reference to public comment, hearings, advisory committees, or consultation with outside parties. It is purely an administrative amendment to a date.
